scene.title: Developers keep asking Claude Code to run destructive commands during debugging
scene.sceneHtml:
TicketFlow: Week 11

Developers keep asking Claude Code to run destructive commands during debugging. You add a PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json that blocks rm -rf and DROP TABLE before they execute. You also document TicketFlow coding standards in CLAUDE.md so every dev session has them loaded automatically.

takeaways: CLAUDE.md at the repo root auto-loads into every Claude Code session; hierarchy: global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, then parent dirs, then project.
Skills live in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md for reusable multi-step workflows; one-liner commands belong in CLAUDE.md instead.
A PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json can deny a tool call before it runs; PostToolUse logs results. Hooks are code, not prompts.
Pin plugin versions in project config and track them in version control so a broken update can be rolled back to a known-good version.
